socket engagement not approved."}},"parts":[{"id":"unloaded_plate_test","role":"coupon","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    grip = p.bolt_length - p.trial_thread_projection
    recess = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_depth_allowance
    total = grip + recess
    shoulder = total - p.test_flank_height
    neck = p.plate_width - 2*p.test_flank_height*math.tan(math.radians(p.test_flank_angle))
    if grip <= 0 or shoulder <= 0 or neck <= p.bolt_head_d + p.head_diametral_allowance:
        raise ValueError('Invalid test dimensions')
    deck = cq.Workplane('XY').rect(p.deck_width,p.plate_length).extrude(shoulder)
    foot = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=shoulder)
            .rect(neck,p.plate_length)
            .workplane(offset=p.test_flank_height)
            .rect(p.plate_width,p.plate_length).loft(combine=True))
    body = deck.union(foot)
    shaft = cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.camera_thread_major+p.hole_diametral_allowance)/2).extrude(total)
    pocket = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=grip)
              .circle((p.bolt_head_d+p.head_diametral_allowance)/2).extrude(recess))
    return body.cut(shaft).cut(pocket)
